description: Take a task and decide for yourself whether it needs a plan, write the plan when it does, and then decide whether the operator has to look — plan and hand off, plan and then implement, or implement with no plan at all. Invoke as `/task <what to do>`. The prompt is a conditional go-ahead scoped to that one task.
